Characteristics [Category]: bulk ATAC-seq chromatin accessibility profiling of an immortalized human keratinocyte cell line
Material Type: Bulk Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing (bulk ATAC-seq) on HaCaT cells, a spontaneously immortalized non-tumorigenic keratinocyte line from adult human skin, similar to epidermal keratinocytes and useful for skin differentiation and barrier biology.
Parameter [dna_extraction]: Bulk ATAC-seq nuclei preparation from adherent keratinocyte cultures: cells are gently lysed to recover nuclei, accessible chromatin is tagmented with Tn5 transposase, and pooled libraries represent population-level regulatory accessibility.
